title: Alarm Prediction in Predictive Maintenance: A Comparative Analysis of Temporal Windows for Machine Learning Models in Industrial Systems
authors: Mario Caterino; Tammaro Ucciero; Riccardo Emanuele Landi; Luca Mozzillo; Antonio Negro; Federico Saponaro; Domenico Soriano; Ivo Surano; Salvatore Miranda; Marcello Fera
reliability_note: Original study on three industrial datasets of future alarm prediction; observation-vs-prediction window tradeoff. Event alarm labels not verified failure occurrence; F1-macro only, lacks PR/ROC and formal statistical tests as authors disclose.
